title: Spare Key — Chapter 3
narration: Then who am I? I asked. The scarred woman said her name was Mara. She placed a hospital bracelet on the table. My photograph was printed beside another name: Evelyn Ward. Admitted eleven months ago, the night Adam and Claire died. Mara said I had been pulled from their burning car with no identification and damage to most of my face. The surgeons reconstructed you from a photograph found in Adam's wallet, she said. Claire's photograph. I touched my cheeks. So Adam never knew me? Mara looked towards Sophie. He visited you every day before the crash. That made no sense. Before I could question her, the kitchen safe clicked open by itself. Adam's key was gone. So was Sophie. My phone vibrated with a photograph of Sophie beside Adam's grave. Beneath it: Bring Evelyn. Claire wants her face back. Mara grabbed my arm. We can't let you remember what you did there.
